scope: Owner request 2026-10-31: 'Use this as a guide for next generation iterative deisgn handoff. Identify the weaknesses of each individual game, giving the racing game particular focus of going through all of the comprehensive versions of this to determine which version (or combination of versions) is best for the final game. Create a hand off to update these games, as well as a self-improvement audit to analyze and continue to develop the existing job minigames'. Read as: apply the record-first method of the 2026-09-30 Day Two job-canon correction (search every branch and record, quote the owner beside each claim, keep decisions apart from proposals) to a generation-2 Codex handoff after the 2026-10-17 rebuild handoff. The packet registers the weaknesses of all 15 live careers and the Arborist Tree Book practice with code anchors and severities (WEAKNESS_REGISTER.md); inventories all ten racing builds in four families with the owner's dated words, finds that the owner's 2026-10-03 priority to convert the existing racing engine and his 2026-10-22 direction to integrate it on castle-room tracks exist only on branches and conflict with ODR-RACER-VIEW-20261018, and recommends a combination R1 (the castle-room Canvas engine with the side-scroller specification's lanes and pit stop and the imp contest, head to head), with R2 as the alternative (RACER_VERSIONS.md); packages the updates NG0-NG12 for Codex, sequenced after the demo build's promotion under ODR-DEMO-FREEZE-20261031 (WORK_PACKAGES.md); and adds a job-specific self-improvement cycle on top of the 2026-10-03 loop and the gold star, with a six-part job lens calibrated against recorded owner verdicts, cycle steps, lessons, tooling needs and a static JC0 baseline (SELF_IMPROVEMENT_AUDIT.md, data/job_lens_jc0.json). Two verified defects become findings: MA-OPERA-015 (two Part 2 story steps hide their touch targets) and MA-ACCESS-004 (eight phases play a recording that is the wrong instruction while the caption is hidden). MA-OPERA-014 and MA-DOC-009 gain history lines; the master audit gains index rows, a task route, a task-index paragraph and a change-history entry; the ledger gains five rows and two stale rows are corrected (the Pop Star specification's pending-answers note; the Racer specification's contested direction). Documentation only: no runtime, save, art, voice or binding-rule change, and no merge into dev before promotion.

acceptance_gaps: The owner's answers to Q1-Q8 (above all Q2, the Racer direction, and Q1, the two demo-route checks). Nothing is implemented: R1 or R2, the Pop Star and Ballerina rebuilds, the Chef look, the Part 2 and free-play repairs, the shared shell, the records and scores, the job-cycle tooling, and every runtime, art, voice, device, child and owner gate. The job lens is calibrated only against the verdicts it was derived from; the owner's next verdicts are its first test. JC1 has not run. The packet stays on its work branch until the demo build is promoted.

lessons.lesson: Before specifying, search every branch for the owner's words on the topic; generation 1 missed the 2026-10-03 racing priority and the Day Two draft missed the job canon.
An owner question lists every recorded option, built branches included; the 2026-10-18 Racer question left out the existing engine.
Record an owner direction in the shared register when it is given; two racing directions exist only on branches, one only in a generated view.
Check each spoken line against its recording's text, not the phase's own text; Boxer and Geologist phases carry a correct caption and a wrong recording.
